approvals.usual: {name} na-agụ, na-achọ ma na-eme faịlụ n’onwe ya, ma na-ebu ụzọ jụọ gị tupu o jiri ịntanetị, bugharịa, hichapụ ma ọ bụ ziga ihe ọ bụla.

approvals.changed.other: Ị gbanwere {count} n’ihe a na-emekarị, nke ọ bụla nwere ntụpọ.

approvals.org.other: Nzukọ gị tọrọ {count} n’ime ndị a, nke ọ bụla nwere akara mkpọchi.

approvals.parent: Nne ma ọ bụ nna họọrọ ndị a. Iji gbanwee otu, jụọ ha.
approvals.askText: {name} na-egosi gị ihe ọ ga-eme, wee chere.
approvals.neverText: {name} na-agwa gị na ọ gaghị ekwe omume, na ihe kpatara ya.
approvals.reserved: Okwuntughe na ịkwụ ụgwọ: naanị gị
approvals.covers.read: Imepe faịlụ i nyere {name}, ma ọ bụ ndị o mere, iji gụọ ha
approvals.covers.edit: Ide faịlụ ọhụrụ, ma ọ bụ ịgbanwe nke {name} mere ma ọ bụ nke i nyere ya
approvals.covers.search: Ịchọ ihe, n’ịntanetị ma ọ bụ na faịlụ gị
approvals.covers.execute: Ịgbakọ ihe nke ọma, site n’ahịrị koodu ole na ole
approvals.covers.fetch: Imepe peeji weebụ, ma ọ bụ iru saịtị
approvals.covers.move: Itinye faịlụ ebe ọzọ, ma ọ bụ inye ya aha ọzọ
approvals.covers.other: Iziga ozi, ikesa ihe, na ihe ọ bụla ọzọ e mere site na sevisi gị
approvals.covers.plan: Ịga n’ihu na atụmatụ nwere ọtụtụ nzọụkwụ
approvals.folders: Na folda i nyere {name}, ọ na-egosi gị mgbanwe ahụ mgbe niile ma buru ụzọ jụọ, n’agbanyeghị ihe a họọrọ ebe a, ma ọ bụrụ na ị kwughị Kwe mgbe niile maka folda ahụ.
approvals.exceptionsText: Ihe i kwere na kaadị, na ihe i mere ka a kpachara anya karịa
approvals.allowedNone: Mgbe {name} jụrụ, Kwe mgbe niile na-edebe azịza gị ebe a, ka i weghachi ya mgbe ọ bụla masịrị gị.
approvals.carefulNone: Buru ụzọ jụọ, ma ọ bụ ọ dịghị mgbe, maka otu ụdị omume ma ọ bụ otu sevisi.
approvals.carefulText: Maka otu ụdị omume ma ọ bụ otu sevisi. Ọ na-eme ka ọ sie ike naanị: ọ dịghị mgbe ọ na-ekwe karịa ihe a na-emekarị.
approvals.ifText: {name} na-ajụ onwe ya nke a tupu nke ọ bụla. Mgbe ọ na-amaghị, a na-agụ ya dị ka ee.
approvals.what.folder: {name} na-agbanwe faịlụ na folda a n’ajụghị
approvals.what.films: A na-eme ha n’ajụghị, n’agbanyeghị na ha na-efu karịa foto
approvals.what.meeting: Ndị inyeaka nke ọrụ ngo ndị a nwere ike izute n’ajụghị
approvals.what.extension: Nwere ike ihapụ omume ka ha gaa n’ihu n’ajụghị gị
approvals.kept: Echekwala ya. Ị nwere ike iweghachi ya na Nkwado.
approvals.what.acts: {name} na-ede, na-eziga ma na-agbanwe ebe ahụ n’ajụghị
approvals.elsewhere: Ọrụ a agụọla ihe si ebe ọzọ, nke nwere ike inwe ntụziaka, ya mere a na-ajụ gị ọzọ.
